title: Three Winters and One Short Coat
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：humanity　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 humanity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the volunteer ① showed the humanity that no refugee in the shelter would have described, and he said the showing was the whole of the Wednesday. The ② humanity, meaning the kindness itself and not the coat, ran three Wednesdays and stayed undescribed in the book; humanity, he said, is the only thing in a shelter that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ piece of humanity in that shelter had the same short coat beside it, and the ④ humanity at the far stove, meaning the blanket they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Humanity, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the volunteer said the describing is the part that fills three Wednesdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the humanity was the whole of the matter, meaning the mercy and not the kindness. The ⑥ humanity, meaning the mercy and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; humanity, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both kindness and a mercy. He said the mercy is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ humanity had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short coat. The ⑧ humanity of the whole thing, the volunteer wrote in February, was one shelter and three Wednesdays of describing; humanity, he said, is either the blanket at the far stove or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ humanity I remember is the humanity described in the record, which closed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest in the shelter. ⑩ Humanity, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being described; all humanity, she said, is a mercy that has agreed to look like kindness. She said the mercy was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 仁爱；人道（指收容所里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 仁爱；人道（指那份善意本身，与外套相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the humanity 展现仁爱
D. n. 仁爱；人道（指留给孩子们留的那一条那一份）
E. n. 人道之事（抽象总称，指一处收容所的仁爱之事）
F. n. 仁爱；人道（指记述里写到、被记下的的那一份）
G. n. 怜悯、人情（指一件事里人人都记却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 人情（抽象总称，指人人都记却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the humanity that no refugee in the shelter would have described
The humanity, meaning the kindness itself and not the coat
Every piece of humanity in that shelter
the humanity at the far stove
the humanity was the whole of the matter
the humanity had become a line in a record
The humanity of the whole thing

answers.why: show the humanity 意为“展现仁爱”，1972 年那位志愿者把收容所里没有一位难民肯描述的一份仁爱做了一遍。
humanity 意为“仁爱；人道”，指那份善意本身而不是外套，它经过了三个星期三而在簿子上没有被描述。
humanity 意为“仁爱；人道”，指收容所里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一件薄薄的外套。
humanity 意为“仁爱；人道”，指最远那个炉子留给孩子们留的那一条那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
humanity 意为“怜悯、人情”，指一件事里人人都记却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份怜悯就是那件事的全部。
humanity 意为“人情”，指人人都记却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份善意，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
humanity 意为“仁爱；人道”，指记述里写到、被记下的的那一份，到 1977 年这一份成了记述里的一行。
humanity 意为“人道之事”，志愿者二月写道，整件事的仁爱之事是一处收容所和三个星期三的描述。
humanity 意为“仁爱；人道”，我记得的是记述里描述过的那一份，1979 年记下了，至今仍被说成收容所里最安静的一份。
humanity 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，仁爱是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的善意。
